title: compile.ts: shape tween (DefineMorphShape2) wrongly uses start-keyframe object id for all frames — ratio always computes 0 after span end
description:
File: packages/swf/src/compile.ts, lines 1140-1192 (shape tween pre-pass)

Bug: In the shape tween pre-pass, the start-keyframe object ID (startObj.id) is used as the canonical key for both objCharIdMap and morphObjSpanInfo. This means on frames AFTER the end of the tween span, when the end keyframe is the governing keyframe, the display object is endObj (which has a different id from startObj). When the frame loop looks up morphShapeObjIds.has(objId) for endObj.id, it returns false, so endObj is processed as a plain shape object — but objCharIdMap.get(endObj.id) returns undefined (since only startObj.id was registered). The shape is silently dropped on the end frame and any frames after it.

Evidence: Consider a 10-frame layer with shape tween from frame 0 to frame 9:
- startObj.id = 'shape-A', endObj.id = 'shape-B'
- Pre-pass registers objCharIdMap.set('shape-A', morphCharId); morphShapeObjIds.add('shape-A')
- endObj.id = 'shape-B' is NEVER added to objCharIdMap or morphShapeObjIds
- Frame 9 (end keyframe): governing frame is end keyframe, obj.id = 'shape-B'
- morphShapeObjIds.has('shape-B') = false → drops into DefineShape4 path
- objCharIdMap.get('shape-B') = undefined → no PlaceObject2 emitted for frame 9

The frame loop condition at compile.ts line 1725 'if (morphRatio === -1) morphRatio = 65535' only fires when morphShapeObjIds.has(objId) is true (line 1712). Since 'shape-B' is never in morphShapeObjIds, the fallthrough is to the normal shape path, not the 65535 fallback.

The same issue exists in sprite.ts once shape tween support is added (task 1130 partially covers this).

Fix prescription:
In the shape tween pre-pass (compile.ts ~line 1159), also register the end object's ID:
  objCharIdMap.set(endObj.id, morphCharId);   // same charId as startObj
  morphShapeObjIds.add(endObj.id);
  // and extend morphObjSpanInfo to cover endObj.id too

This ensures the frame loop finds both startObj.id and endObj.id as morph shapes and emits PlaceObject2WithRatio for all frames including the final keyframe.

Acceptance test: scene with a shape-tween layer spanning frames 0-9; after compile, verify PlaceObject2 with HasRatio is emitted for frame 9 (ratio=65535) and the end object's character ID matches the DefineMorphShape2 character ID.
